forum.title: STM32CubeMX2
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @DmitryR

Great to see your interest in our STM32Cube ecosystem.

As you have noticed, we are introducing some updates along with the release of support for the STM32C5 series. Unfortunately, the ecosystem is not yet available at the time of the STM32C5 launch. However, it will be released next week, including the update of STM32CubeMX, named STM32CubeMX2.

Best Regards,

Emil
forum.content_text:
Hi all,

in the release note of the STM32C5 family it is mentioned that the family will be supported with STM32CubeMX2. May I please ask when is it going to be available?

With best regards,

Dmitry
forum.author: DmitryR

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @DmitryR 

Please stay tuned, this will be released soon.
scraped_replies.author: FBL

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @DmitryR 

 

Great to see your interest in our STM32Cube ecosystem.

As you have noticed, we are introducing some updates along with the release of support for the STM32C5 series. Unfortunately, the ecosystem is not yet available at the time of the STM32C5 launch. However, it will be released next week, including the update of STM32CubeMX, named STM32CubeMX2.

 

Best Regards,

Emil
scraped_replies.author: Emil Damkjaer PETERSEN

scraped_replies.html:
Hi  @DmitryR 

Thank you for your interest in STM32CubeMX2.

I’m pleased to inform you that STM32CubeMX2 has been released and is now available at:
https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/stm32cubemx.html

Please try it out and don’t hesitate to open new community posts to share your feedback.

Regards,

Sara.
